LanguageData.RKU_Storytellers_Hyacinth.label: "Tenacity" Hyacinth
LanguageData.RKU_Storytellers_Hyacinth.description: Hyacinth is a veteran who survived the revolutionary army era. She once fought against the Kingdom's tyranny alongside Reilainei alongside Acacia's leadership. Although the revolution ultimately failed due to Azalea's biological weapon plague, the Eastern Front forces maintained their combat effectiveness, dispersing into underground work...\nHyacinth will provide more stable partisan-related events, as well as more frequent combat.
